Looking for a healthy, delicious, and colorful addition to your daily meals? At Suhani’s Tiffins, we believe that healthy food should never be boring!

Check out our beautifully crafted diced salad, packed with the natural goodness of crunchy carrots, hydrating cucumbers, earthy beetroots, and finely chopped onions. Finished with premium microgreens, fresh herbs, and a touch of elegance, it’s a feast for both your eyes and your health.

Ever tried Rakti? If you know, you know! For those who haven’t, this is a deep dive into the rich, traditional culinary heritage of Maharashtra—especially loved in the Koli and Agri communities.
​Made from fresh goat blood, Rakti is a unique, flavorful delicacy. The blood is first gently boiled until it firms up like soft tofu or paneer, then scrambled and slow-cooked with finely chopped onions, ginger-garlic paste, aromatic spices, and a generous handful of fresh coriander and mint.
​The result? A rich, savory, and intensely flavorful dish that pairs beautifully with piping hot Bajra or Jowar Bhakri.
